## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run build` passes or the repository build workflow is green.
- [ ] I tested the affected route or workflow.
- [ ] For visual/UI changes, I reviewed the result at the intended viewport using an Appshot or screenshot.
- [ ] For visual/UI changes, the post-fix image confirms the reported defect is resolved.
- [ ] No passwords, API keys, tokens, private financial data, or other unnecessary sensitive information are included in visual evidence.
- [ ] Authentication, tenant isolation, RLS, and server-only secrets were not weakened.

## Visual evidence

For UI changes, attach before/after Appshots or screenshots or link the related visual-bug issue.
